configuration_status: Fixed current TRAIN-only engineering choices before this full-data fit; no earliest-preregistration claim
source_grouping: split:task:original_parent_raw_episode_id; all teacher/hold replicas retain one parent identity
completed_skill_support_unit: distinct original TRAIN parents per exact phase/anchor/reference-kind/manipulated-role/mode partition
failed_or_incomplete_attempt_policy: Preserve raw rows and right-censored durations; do not use incomplete attempts as completed skill curves or substitute original HDF5 priors for native body SE3

required_release_contract.origin: Existing release/fitter hard requirements, retained without weakening

engineering_choice_notes.interaction: 21 uniform progress knots; five fixed 50ms lag candidates up to 200ms selected only by grouped TRAIN crossfit; 95th parent duration/terminal-residual quantiles; 5mm/0.03rad positive numerical floors; 90% lag sample coverage while every completed attempt must remain represented. Existing 8-parent and 3cm/0.15rad caps remain hard gates; residuals are never clipped to pass.
engineering_choice_notes.colour: Normalized CIELAB units, not RGB255 or metres. Eight fit parents per class are required in each of two disjoint TRAIN folds, so 16 total parents per colour is a necessary lower bound. Current pixel support is at least20, prototype radius floor0.05, nearest-class margin0.02, maximum observation age0.1s, macro-parent correct-and-supported CV fraction0.95. These are current TRAIN-only fixed choices, not a paper-reported or earliest-preregistered setting.
engineering_choice_notes.rigid_layout: Validate only the existing declared frame/peg-or-spoke and button/wrap pairs. At least8 distinct parents and5 valid native pose samples in every declared rollout, with5mm/0.03rad maximum residuals. Every declared parent/rollout remains audited; a short or invalid case is reported, not silently removed.
engineering_choice_notes.selection_scope: No grid search over this configuration, no VAL/TEST labels or outcomes, no automatic threshold relaxation. Any later TRAIN development revision must receive a new version and new frozen fit provenance. Passing this configuration does not itself release a formal comparison.
